name: PianoFlow: Piano & MIDI
subtitle: Play, practice, record piano
promotionalText: Make every note yours. Play an expressive 88-key piano, follow sheet music, build your rhythm, and keep your performances on iPhone, iPad, and iPhone Duo.
description:
A piano for the moments you want to play.

PianoFlow brings an expressive 88-key keyboard, guided practice, and a personal recording studio to iPhone and iPad. Ivory and ebony keys, warm brass details, and native Liquid Glass controls keep your music at the center.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Play chords and glissandos with independent finger tracking. Move across A0–C8 with octave shortcuts and a range slider. Adjust key width, labels, volume, and touch feedback to suit your session. Add sustain and see the chords you play.

PRACTICE WITH PURPOSE
Explore scales, arpeggios, chords, and familiar melodies. Follow highlighted keys and scrolling sheet music. Practice at your own pace, or choose Rhythm coach for a count-in, a synchronized metronome, and note-onset feedback. Practice either hand or both, set a tempo goal, and build a daily habit with progress stored on your device.

BRING YOUR OWN MUSIC
Import a Standard MIDI file from Files, choose its tracks, and assign parts to each hand. Connect a compatible USB or Bluetooth MIDI keyboard for velocity-sensitive playing and sustain-pedal input.

KEEP THE PERFORMANCE
Record notes, velocity, and sustain. Rename a take, save a trimmed copy, loop a section, or change playback speed. Share your performance as MIDI, WAV, or M4A. Recordings and imported songs stay in your local library.

ROOM TO PLAY
PianoFlow adapts to iPhone, iPad, and the inner and outer displays of iPhone Duo. Larger Text, VoiceOver labels, Reduce Motion, and high-contrast controls help you make the instrument your own.

PIANOFLOW PREMIUM
An optional one-time purchase removes ads and adds Warm Studio and Bright Hall sound profiles. Concert Grand and the core playing, practice, and recording features remain available without Premium.

MIDI import supports Standard MIDI formats 0 and 1 with PPQN timing. Imported notation may be simplified; rhythm feedback grades note onsets, not note lengths. External MIDI hardware and compatible adapters are sold separately.
whatsNew:
• Native Liquid Glass controls with accessible fallbacks
• Layout refinements for iPhone Duo, iPad, and Larger Text
• More stable audio recovery, playback, and recording storage
• Faster score rendering and safer MIDI importing
• Keyboard, practice, and purchase reliability fixes
